verses.en: In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful.
Surely, man is in a state of loss,

verses.ar: اِلَّا الَّذِیۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوۡا بِالۡحَقِّ ۬ۙ وَتَوَاصَوۡا بِالصَّبۡرِ ﴿٪۴﴾
verses.en: Except those who believe and do good works, and exhort one another to accept truth, and exhort one another to be steadfast.
